description: Knowledge base for the AI-search suite. Each golden policy is split into atomic passages, and there are near-duplicate distractors so ranking quality matters.

documents.title: Return window
documents.text: Sauce Demo Store accepts returns within 45 days of delivery.

documents.title: Return condition
documents.text: Returned items must be unused and in original packaging.

documents.title: Refund timing
documents.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of receiving the return.

documents.title: Standard shipping fee
documents.text: Standard shipping costs $4.99 for orders under $75.

documents.title: Free shipping threshold
documents.text: Orders of $75 or more ship free with standard shipping.

documents.title: Express shipping
documents.text: Express shipping costs $14.99 regardless of order size.

documents.title: Bike Light warranty term
documents.text: The Sauce Labs Bike Light has a 2-year limited warranty.

documents.title: Warranty coverage
documents.text: The warranty covers manufacturing defects and battery failure.

documents.title: Warranty exclusions
documents.text: The warranty does not cover water damage or accidental drops.

documents.title: Support hours
documents.text: Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Central European Time.

documents.title: Support closures
documents.text: Support is closed on weekends and public holidays.

documents.title: Accepted payments
documents.text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal and Sauce gift cards. Cash on delivery is not available.

documents.title: Backpack care
documents.text: The Sauce Labs Backpack is water resistant and can be wiped clean with a damp cloth.

documents.title: Fleece Jacket sizing
documents.text: The Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket runs one size small; order a size up.

documents.title: Newsletter
documents.text: Subscribers to the Sauce newsletter get early access to seasonal sales.
